title: Redeploy clean production build to live domain (fix NXDOMAIN)

requirements.text: Perform a forced clean production rebuild of the current codebase (clear frontend caches/build artifacts) and ensure the production build completes successfully (no build errors).

quotes: Please redeploy the project and ensure the production build completes successfully.

acceptanceCriteria: A clean rebuild is executed such that prior build artifacts and caches are cleared before building.
The production build finishes successfully and produces fresh build artifacts (e.g., a new dist/ output) with no errors.

requirements.text: Deploy the clean production build directly to the live environment so the live domain https://areaworkars.caffeine.ai is created and serves the app; do not create or publish any draft/preview deployment as part of this redeploy.

quotes: The domain areaworkars.caffeine.ai is not created (NXDOMAIN).
Do a fresh production deployment, not draft preview.

acceptanceCriteria: The live deployment completes successfully without creating/publishing a draft/preview deployment.
DNS for areaworkars.caffeine.ai resolves (no NXDOMAIN) and https://areaworkars.caffeine.ai loads the application in a browser after deployment.

requirements.text: Add a deployment verification step after the live deploy that checks the live URL (https://areaworkars.caffeine.ai) returns a successful response and renders the app shell (not a blank page) so deployment failures are detected immediately.
acceptanceCriteria: After the live deploy, an explicit verification is performed against https://areaworkars.caffeine.ai.
Verification confirms the site is reachable and the app renders (not an error page and not a blank white screen).

constraints: Deploy to the live domain https://areaworkars.caffeine.ai (not a draft/preview).
Use English for any user-facing text in this build request.
nonGoals: No UI/UX changes beyond what is required to produce a successful production build and live deployment.
No new product features or backend schema changes unless required strictly to fix build/deploy failure.
No custom domain setup; only the Caffeine subdomain areaworkars.caffeine.ai is in scope.
